text:
Which statement about metals and their uses is correct?
A
Aluminium is used to make food containers because it is resistant to corrosion.
B
Aluminium is used to make aircraft wings because it is strong and has a high density.
C
Iron is used to make electrical wires because it is a good insulator of electricity.
D
Iron is used to make cooking utensils because it is easily recycled.

options.label: A
options.text: Aluminium is used to make food containers because it is resistant to corrosion.

options.label: B
options.text: Aluminium is used to make aircraft wings because it is strong and has a high density.

options.label: C
options.text: Iron is used to make electrical wires because it is a good insulator of electricity.

options.label: D
options.text: Iron is used to make cooking utensils because it is easily recycled.
